facts.quote: Cada jueves el Equipo Comunitario se congrega en un lugar diferente para festejar.

article_summaries.title: Evento Comunitario: Fiesta de Inicio al 2011
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official freerealms.com community event notice announcing the first community party of 2011, held on a stage in Snowy Hill on Server 1. The Community Team said it gathers at a different location each Thursday, and players were asked to bring favorite outfits and boomboxes. Event times are given per region in Pacific Time.
